title: Discord Kitten
blurb: Few phrases summon a more specific mental image than Discord kitten — the meme about Nitro gifts flowing one way and affection flowing the other, filed permanently under cursed. This audio exists so you can make the accusation without typing it, which is both faster and considerably funnier. Use it when somebody boosts a server suspiciously quickly, when a gift arrives with no explanation attached, or simply to derail a voice chat inside a second. Bear in mind that certain allegations cannot be walked back, and that the group chat has an extremely long memory.
origin: From the 'Discord kitten' meme about Nitro-fueled server dynamics.
